metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Sure, you’re a legend now’ but I’m still confused LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I even aim at the enemy?
They probably paused to uninstall.
Click if you’ve ever got kills that made no sense at all!
Valorant’s logic is peak chaos.

Tap in if your kills feel like pure luck every time!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
